meta.purpose: Route every Leadsy automation event through one configurable n8n workflow.
meta.preserves: Leadsy remains the application backend, auth/RBAC boundary, and Postgres source of truth.

routes.name: Lead Added
routes.purpose: Start qualification, summary, and task orchestration after Leadsy owns the lead record.
routes.trigger: Leadsy stores a new lead from manual intake, Meta, WhatsApp, or extension sync.
routes.preserves: Lead CRUD and lead storage stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Lead Updated
routes.purpose: Refresh only the intelligence artifacts affected by the changed fields.
routes.trigger: Leadsy updates contact, status, task, knowledge, or communication fields.
routes.preserves: Lead updates and tenant checks stay in Leadsy APIs.

routes.name: Research Requested
routes.purpose: Coordinate research while keeping evidence, spend, and saved records inside Leadsy.
routes.trigger: Operator or schedule asks Leadsy to research a lead or research request.
routes.preserves: OpenRouter calls stay behind the Leadsy provider abstraction.

routes.name: Qualification Requested
routes.purpose: Score fit/urgency and decide whether task or approval routing is needed.
routes.trigger: Lead added, lead updated, WhatsApp message received, or operator request.
routes.preserves: Qualification result storage stays in Leadsy.

routes.name: Task Generated
routes.purpose: Route approvals, due reminders, and retry schedules around Leadsy task state.
routes.trigger: Leadsy creates an extension, CRM, or follow-up task.
routes.preserves: Task CRUD and status transitions stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Approval Requested
routes.purpose: Create a central approval item and pause downstream automation until reviewed.
routes.trigger: Research, task, note, draft, outreach, or qualification output requires human review.
routes.preserves: Leadsy remains the human approval gate before outbound sends.

routes.name: Follow-up Due
routes.purpose: Surface due follow-ups and create approved draft paths when useful.
routes.trigger: n8n scheduled due check or task due timestamp.
routes.preserves: Follow-up task state stays in Leadsy.

routes.name: Meta Lead Received
routes.purpose: Run post-storage qualification and approval routing for Meta-originated leads.
routes.trigger: Existing Leadsy Meta route stores a Meta-derived lead or communication.
routes.preserves: Public Meta webhooks continue to terminate at Leadsy.

routes.name: WhatsApp Message Received
routes.purpose: Generate reply suggestions, refresh qualification, and route approvals.
routes.trigger: Existing Leadsy WhatsApp/Meta route stores an inbound WhatsApp message.
routes.preserves: WhatsApp message handling and storage stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Worker Retry
routes.purpose: Retry only safe worker actions and escalate exhausted/non-retryable failures.
routes.trigger: Worker task failed, blocked, postponed, or reached retry due time.
routes.preserves: Leadsy keeps worker task state while the extension remains the capture/execution layer.
